create.name: Theresa Cheung
create.bio:
Theresa Cheung is an English writer on dreams, intuition and the unexplained, who studied theology and English at King's College, Cambridge, and has spent several decades writing popular books on spiritual and psychic themes. Her Dream Dictionary from A to Z is a standard reference for many dreamers, and her many other titles include How to Catch a Dream, a three-week programme for lucid dreaming, and Dreaming of Your Future, on dreams that seem to anticipate events. She works closely with researchers studying consciousness, writes for the Institute of Noetic Sciences, and is a regular dream interpreter on British daytime television.

Her teaching comes mostly through books, broadcasting and talks. For several years she hosted the White Shores podcast, long conversations with scientists, authors and spiritual teachers about dreams, intuition and the afterlife, and she now co-hosts a weekly live radio show on dreams with Kelly Sullivan Walden. She programmes talks for the Mind Body Spirit festivals in London and gives dream-decoding workshops and webinars at festivals and for companies. Her approach is practical and curious: she encourages readers to keep a dream journal, notice symbols and coincidences, and treat intuition as a skill that grows with attention. She also co-hosted a dreamwork summit for The Shift Network.

books.title: The Dream Dictionary from A to Z
books.author: Theresa Cheung
books.description: Her best-known reference book: an alphabetical guide to dream symbols and what they may suggest, with cross-references between related images. This is the Thunder Bay edition.

books.title: How to Catch a Dream
books.author: Theresa Cheung
books.description: A three-week programme of 21 short practices for remembering dreams and learning to dream lucidly, and for carrying that awareness into daily life.

books.title: Dreaming of Your Future: Unlock the Precognitive Secrets of Your Mind
books.author: Theresa Cheung
books.description: Exercises for noticing dreams that seem to point ahead, with a directory of dream symbols grouped by theme. Published by Llewellyn in 2025.

free_resources.title: White Shores Podcast
free_resources.description: Her podcast archive of more than 300 conversations, from 2019 to 2026, with scientists, authors and spiritual teachers on dreams, intuition, consciousness and the afterlife.

free_resources.title: The Healing Power of Your Dreams (weekly radio show)
free_resources.description: A live weekly radio hour on dreams, co-hosted with Kelly Sullivan Walden, with guests from dream research, psychology and spirituality. Free to listen live or on catch-up.
